reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; the score has bars of another length (bar 4, 5), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 001153 (the melody read from 001153a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Richard Redhead's dates (1820–1901) are from our page for the tune GETHSEMANE (content/hymns/tunes/gethsemane.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001153a.nwc).
